title: Speculative Pruning
tagline: Compare four search pruning strategies by their estimated work as problem size grows under branch-and-bound style exploration.

curves.label: Plain Bound
curves.code: for (let node=0; node<n; node++) { expand(node); if (lowerBound(node) >= incumbent) continue; }
curves.name: Plain Bound

curves.label: LP Relax Tighten
curves.code: for (let node=0; node<n; node++) { let lb = solveLPRelax(node); if (lb >= incumbent) prune(node); else expand(node); }
curves.name: LP Relax Tighten

curves.label: Learned Surrogate
curves.code: for (let node=0; node<n; node++) { let lb = surrogatePredict(node); if (lb >= incumbent) prune(node); else expand(node); }
curves.name: Learned Surrogate

curves.label: Dominance Prune
curves.code: for (let node=0; node<n; node++) { let state = represent(node); if (dominates(state, paretoFront)) continue; insertPareto(paretoFront, state); }
curves.name: Dominance Prune

curves.label: Exponential Baseline
curves.code: function dfs(k){ if(k===n){record(); return;} dfs(k+1); dfs(k+1); } dfs(0);
curves.name: Exponential Baseline
